title: Implementation Plan for Interactive 3D Retro-Tech Landing Page

steps.description: Create the standalone interactive 3D landing page. This includes the Three.js scene setup, the custom ShaderMaterial for the 'Cyber-Grid' effect (neon cyan/glowing vertices), the 3D wireframe model logic, and the 2D CSS/Canvas overlay for CRT scanlines and glassmorphic UI components.
steps.testCriteria: The page renders a 3D wireframe model with neon cyan highlights, responds to Y-axis rotation, and displays a visible CRT scanline overlay over the UI elements.

verificationGateChecklist: AST code health clean (no empty catch, no any)
